source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
	BILLER_ID
	,BILLER_SERVICE_ID
	,PAYMENT_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(PAYMENT_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PAYMENT_DATE
	,PAYMENT_AMT
	,BILL_CCY
	,PAYMENT_TYPE
	,ACCT_NO
	,CHECK_NO
	,CHECK_TYPE
	,BANK_CODE
	,BRSTN
	,MC_DD_NO
	,BARCODE
	,SUBSCRIBER_NO
	,PHONE_NO
	,CARD_NO
	,CARD_TYPE
	,MERALCO_REF_NO
	,POLICY_NO
	,POLICY_TYPE
	,AREA
	,INSURANCE_TYPE
	,INVOICE_NO
	,NAME_OF_INSURED
	,STUDENT_ID
	,CAMPUS
	,STUDENT_NAME
	,PRODUCT_CODE
	,INSTITUTION_CODE
	,CORPORATE_NAME
	,TRANSACTION_CODE
	,COUNTRY_CODE
	,REMITTER
	,BENEFICIARY
	,BENEFICIARY_TIN
	,REF_TRANSMITTAL_NO
	,REPRESENTATIVE_NAME
	,AMLA_CODE
	,BANK_MNEMONIC
	,COMB_STRING
	,LATE_CHECK_PAYMENT_FLG
	,TRAN_ID_BY_PUB
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(TRAN_DATE_BY_PUB, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE_BY_PUB
	,BILLER_PAYMENT_TRAN_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(BILLER_PAYMENT_TRAN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS BILLER_PAYMENT_TRAN_DATE
	,REVERSE_FLG
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(REVERSE_CRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS REVERSE_CRE_TIME
	,REVERSE_CRE_USER_ID
	,REVERSAL_TRAN_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(REVERSAL_TRAN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS REVERSAL_TRAN_DATE
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,DEL_FLG
	,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
	,SOL_ID
	,BANK_ID
	,SET_NUM
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(ZONE_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS ZONE_DATE
	,ZONE_CODE
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE, INSERT_DTTM) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM D360.STG_DEP_CPYBPDET
